metric: Physical owning-storage copies classified against later reference-semantic observations by monotonic version ID. AVOIDABLE means no later observation under the stated metric, not a proof that the copy is removable. PAYLOAD_COPY is the only group carrying the headline.
native_path: native O0 unbounded mechanism census joined to reference versions; O0 preserves the emitter's copy decisions and makes no claim about which copies survive O2.

fuzz:5130572.reason: Zero events. The generated families declare a four-argument (v,s,s,s) entry and the census harness supplies two byte arguments, so every family stops at "E006 entry arity mismatch expected:4 got:2" before executing. Parity between the instrumented and ordinary runs still held, so this is a harness gap, not a measurement that copies are absent. A dedicated helper supplying a Buffer and three Bytes arguments is required.

map_cow.bytes_measure: map entries, keys, values and index

map_value_extract.bytes_measure: value bytes materialized out of a map

excluded.reason: Fresh sequence for a constructed or decoded value; no pre-existing logical source.
Literal materialization from HIR, not from a runtime value version.
Constructor fill; the only source is a scalar fill value.
Zero-length entry and index allocation; no payload bytes.
Host argument vector decoded once before execution begins.
Host input materialization; the source is outside the program semantics.
Decoded i64 vector built from text; separate logical value.
Reconstructs a record from packed map bytes; the map copy itself is counted.
Formats a scalar into fresh bytes; no sequence payload is duplicated.
Scalar to text; reached only through Format.
Packs record cells for map storage; its observation is recorded so the map copy classifies.
Tooling-only rendering, unreachable from program semantics.
Clones Value handles. Sequence, map and record handles are Arc pointers, so no payload moves; any payload duplication appears at the Storage::clone hook instead.
Shared literal allocator. Its payload-copying callers at 511 and 516 are hooked individually; the construction and env/format callers are excluded here.
Host input materialization; the source lies outside the program semantics.
Packs a record into map bytes; the enclosing map update is counted.
Buffer and record-buffer fill loops; no pre-existing logical source.
Unique-path capacity growth. realloc can remap without copying, so a byte count here would be an invented memcpy; reported as uninstrumented rather than estimated.
Eight-byte scalar move for printing.
Covered by the map_rebuild aggregate at 537, which sums entry, key and value bytes. Not a separate total: adding per-memcpy hooks would double count the same bytes.

ledger.note: REQUIRED/AVOIDABLE is published for PAYLOAD_COPY. Other groups are reported per group and never folded into that headline. AVOIDABLE means no later reference observation of the source version under the stated metric, not a proof that the copy is removable.
